rental_conditions.driver_license_requirements: Must have been issued at least one year before rental date, EU license or international driving permit
rental_conditions.fuel_policy: Must return with same fuel level as received
rental_conditions.mileage_policy: Minimum 100 km per day, unlimited for rentals of 3+ days
rental_conditions.gps_fee: 10 euro/day (less than 5 days), 5 euro/day (more than 5 days)
rental_conditions.cancellation_policy: 15% charge if canceled less than 3 days before arrival
rental_conditions.payment_methods: VISA, Master Card, AMEX, Diners Club
rental_conditions.cash_deposit: Not accepted except in special cases
rental_conditions.one_way_rental_fee: Available with special fee upon request
